description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Abhayapura, Lankapura D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District (25/0214)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and property ownership matters. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, lists property owners, and includes details about land extents, encumbrances, and ownership status. The document is explicitly published under "PART III - LANDS" and references the Registration of Title Act, focusing on cadastral mapping and land parcel registrations in specific locations. This fits the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
